headline: PHI @ NYM matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is PHI 4.89 at NYM 3.91, with a projected total of 8.80. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward PHI: PHI moved +0.66 runs while NYM moved -0.20, changing the projected margin by +0.86 runs. The projected total climbed +0.46, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +7.2%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Zack Wheeler has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Bo Bichette, Juan Soto, Brandon Marsh, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Brett Baty, MJ Melendez because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
